get_company.description: Get a company's page as structured data, including its current raise, past rounds and the three raised amounts the page shows.
get_company.name: get_company

parameters.description: A Wefunder company ID or slug.
parameters.name: company_id

data.description: The company page as structured data. Monetary fields are USD decimal strings.

current_raise.description: The live round the page shows, or null when `raising` is false. A funded company still has its history in `wefunder_rounds` and the page's ticker in `totals`.

facebook_url.description: The company's Facebook page, as an absolute URL. Null when none is set.

instagram_url.description: The company's Instagram profile, as an absolute URL. Null when none is set.

legal_form.description: The company's legal form as the company entered it, free text and not normalized (e.g. "Corporation", "Limited Liability Company", "llc"). The form on a filed Form C is `business.legal_form` in `/disclosures`. The EIN is deliberately not served.

legal_name.description: The company's legal name, as the company entered it. The name on a filed Form C is `business.legal_name` in `/disclosures`.

linkedin_url.description: The company's LinkedIn page, as an absolute URL. Null when none is set.

past_rounds.description: The prior rounds the company page's ticker folds in (its own accounting; see `totals.profile_*`). Not the company's full Wefunder history — that is `wefunder_rounds`.

promotion_opt_in.description: The company's answer to "Who should be able to see your campaign?" on wefunder.com: true for "as public as possible" (eligible for the Explore page and Wefunder's marketing), false for "as private as possible". False does not hide the company or its rounds — anything this API returns is visible to the caller — but the company has asked not to be promoted, so an app that redistributes listings should respect it.

raising.description: True when the round the page shows this viewer is live (accepting investments or reservations). False for a funded company, or one with no round the viewer may see.

profile_includes_past_rounds.description: Whether the page's ticker currently folds past rounds into its total. Null when the viewer may see no round (no ticker to read).

profile_total_raised.description: The number on the company page's ticker bar — the current raise plus the past rounds the page folds in (which may include founder-reported off-platform rounds and exclude older Wefunder rounds).

raised_on_wefunder_all_time.description: Sum of `wefunder_rounds[].amount_raised` — everything this company has raised on Wefunder that the viewer may see. The lifetime figure.

twitter_url.description: The company's X (Twitter) profile, as an absolute URL (a stored handle is expanded). Null when none is set.

website_url.description: The company's website, as an absolute URL. Null when none is set or the stored value is not a usable link.

wefunder_rounds.description: Every round this company has run on Wefunder that the viewer may see, live and closed, newest first, each with its own metric. Independent of what the page's ticker chooses to include.

data.description: The company's public Form C disclosures (the site's Details tab), one section per key. A section is null when the company hides it on the site.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code, upper-case, of the round's own figures: `use_of_funds`, `prior_offerings`, `outstanding_notes`, `outstanding_debts` and `related_parties`. The round's currency — `USD` for a Reg CF round, `EUR` for an ECSP round. The financial statements, `ratios.revenue_per_employee` and `current_position` are in `financials_currency` instead.

current_position.description: The founder's own disclosure of where the company stands today, each field when supplied.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code every amount in this object is denominated in. Equals the top-level `financials_currency` (the currency the founder declared for the financial statements; the same field feeds these figures on the disclosures editor).

exemption.description: The offering's SEC exemption, in market vocabulary.

sec_filing_url.description: The filing on sec.gov, when filed.

statement_date.description: The date the financial statements are as of.

financial_condition.description: The issuer's financial-condition narrative, plain text.

financial_statements.description: One column per fiscal year on file; a year with no figures is omitted.

most_recent.description: One fiscal year's figures from the Form C, decimal strings in the payload's `financials_currency` (null where not reported).

prior.description: One fiscal year's figures from the Form C, decimal strings in the payload's `financials_currency` (null where not reported).

prior_prior.description: One fiscal year's figures from the Form C, decimal strings in the payload's `financials_currency` (null where not reported).

financials_currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the financial statements AND the founder's current-position figures (cash on hand, average monthly revenue, cost of goods, expenses) and `ratios.revenue_per_employee`. Falls back to `currency`. On the disclosures editor these fields share one denomination, which is this one. ISO 4217 code, upper-case, of the Form C `financial_statements` and of `ratios.revenue_per_employee`. The currency the issuer declared for its statements; equals `currency` unless the iss

investment_documents.description: The contracts an investor signs (the page's "Investment Terms").

offering_id.description: The round whose Form C this is (`ofr_...`).

note.description: A company-specific note the site shows instead of the table, when set.

prior_offerings.description: Exempt offerings in the prior three years, as disclosed.

ratios.description: The page's at-a-glance ratios for the most recent fiscal year, percentages as decimal strings; null where the page shows N/A, or the whole block null when hidden for this company.

debt_to_assets_percent.description: Deprecated alias of `liabilities_to_assets_percent` (same value). Will be removed in a future dated version.

liabilities_to_assets_percent.description: (Current + non-current liabilities) / total assets × 100. Liabilities, not debt — see `current_liabilities`.

risks.description: The issuer's risk factors, in the page's order, plain text.

use_of_funds.description: How the company says it will use the money at each amount raised.

voting_power.description: Holders of 20% or more of voting power, as disclosed.

get_offering.description: Get one fundraise by its ID. Private rounds can't be viewed with public access, even with a valid ID.
get_offering.name: get_offering

parameters.description: The offering's id (`ofr_...`).
parameters.name: external_id

data.description: A public offering (a fundraise), addressed by its id (`ofr_...`). Returned by the Explore endpoints. Monetary fields are USD decimal strings — parse them as decimals, not floats.

amount_raised.description: Amount raised so far **by this offering** in USD, as a decimal string (hellbanned investors excluded). Not the company's lifetime total, and not the combined figure the company's Wefunder page shows when a Reg D round runs alongside — see `warnings`.

business_models.description: The company's curated business-model tags, as `{ type, label }`. Filterable via `business_model`.

items.description: A curated company tag — a machine value plus the label the site shows.

card_image_url.description: Absolute URL of the explore card image, or null if the company has none.

closed_at.description: When the round finished raising. Null while the round is upcoming or open (the scheduled close is `closes_at`); set only once `status` is `closed`.

closes_at.description: When an open round is scheduled to stop accepting investments. Null when no date is set or the round is not open. A round can remain open past this date until it is actually closed, so use `status`, not this date against the clock, to decide whether it accepts investments.

exemption.description: The offering's SEC exemption, in market vocabulary.

family.description: `other` appears only on a company's past rounds, for a reported round under an exemption outside this list (e.g. Section 4(a)(2)). `reg_cf` — Regulation Crowdfunding: open to all investors, with per-investor annual limits set by the SEC; amounts and investor counts are public. `reg_d` — Regulation D private placement: `506c` is open to verified accredited investors only and may be advertised; `506b` is by invitation and never publicly listed. `reg_a`, `reg_s` and `ecsp` exist

label.description: Human-readable label in normal market language.

subtype.description: Sub-type/flavor — `506b` or `506c` for the `reg_d` family, otherwise null.

followed.description: **Logged-in view only** (`read:explore`). Whether the authorizing user follows this company on wefunder.com (their watchlist). Absent in the public view.

form_c_url.description: The round's latest accepted Form C (or Form C/A amendment) on SEC EDGAR, a public sec.gov URL. Reg CF rounds only; null until the Form C is filed and for every other exemption. For the round a company page shows, the same filing is `filing.sec_filing_url` in `GET /companies/{id}/disclosures`.

funding_target.description: Funding target in USD, as a decimal string.

industries.description: The company's curated industry tags (the ones the site's explore page filters by), as `{ type, label }`. Empty when none are set. Filterable via `industry`.

items.description: A curated company tag — a machine value plus the label the site shows.

intended_security.description: Testing-the-Waters rounds only: the kind of security the company says it intends to issue when the round opens, with no terms (none are final). Null for a live round, and for a TTW round whose terms are still to be decided.

invested.description: **Logged-in view only** (`read:explore`). Whether the authorizing user has an active investment in this offering. Absent in the public view.

investor_count.description: Distinct investor count for this offering (hellbanned investors excluded).

logo_url.description: Absolute URL of the company logo, or null if the company has none.

max_funding_target.description: The most this round may raise, in USD as a decimal string (the same denomination as `funding_target`). For a Reg CF round, the maximum offering amount on its Form C (the largest funding tier); otherwise the maximum the company set for the round. Null when neither exists. Raising past `funding_target` up to this amount is normal.

min_investment.description: Minimum investment in USD, as a decimal string.

publicly_visible.description: **Logged-in view only** (`read:explore`). `false` when a logged-out visitor could not see this offering — it is in the response only because of who the authorizing user is (accredited, invited, Vault/syndicate member). Absent in the public view.

spv_legal_name.description: The legal name of the Wefunder SPV (a series LLC that co-issues the round) that investors hold through, e.g. "WF Acme 2025, a series of Wefunder SPV, LLC". Null when investors hold the security directly.

status.description: Where the round is in its life. `open` accepts investments (or reservations, for a Testing-the-Waters round); `closed` finished raising; `upcoming` is not yet accepting (insiders only); `canceled` was aborted. How close an open round is to closing is `closes_at`; whether it is over target is `amount_raised` vs `funding_target`.

testing_the_waters.description: True for Testing-the-Waters rounds, which collect non-binding **reservations**, not investments. Use "reserve"/"reservation" copy for these, "invest"/"investment" otherwise.

company.description: The parent company's id (`co_...`). Resolve it with `GET /companies/{id}`.

etag.description: Content digest of this offering's public payload (`attributes`), for client-side change detection when polling. `warnings` are not included.

warnings.description: Context for reading this offering's numbers correctly. Empty for most offerings. `concurrent_rounds`: the company has other open rounds (e.g. a Reg D round alongside this one), so the company's Wefunder page shows a combined total larger than `amount_raised`. `prior_rounds`: the company completed earlier rounds on Wefunder, so `amount_raised` is not its lifetime total. Not part of the `etag`.

parameters.description: A Wefunder company ID or slug.

parameters.name: sections

schema.description: Only these sections (`offering_id`, `title`, `url`, `authored_by`, and `disclaimer` are always included). Omit for the whole pitch. Unknown names are a 400 listing the vocabulary.

data.description: The company page's pitch (the Overview tab's story) as ordered blocks, plus the round's perk tiers.

authored_by.description: `company`: the founder wrote the story. `wefunder`: a Wefunder-prepared deal memo the company did not participate in.

disclaimer.description: The page's notice on a Wefunder-prepared deal memo; null when the company authored the story.

offering_id.description: The round the page shows this viewer (`ofr_...`), whose perks these are; null when the viewer may see none.

perks.description: The perk tiers the page shows; null when the viewer may see no round.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code the tier amounts are denominated in, e.g. `USD` or `EUR`.

described_in_pitch.description: Heuristic. True when the tiers are a placeholder ("See investor overview page", or one identical short sentence on every tier) and the real perks are in the story, usually as images.

offering_id.description: The round these perks belong to (`ofr_...`) when it is the round the page shows. Null when the sidebar reads a round the viewer cannot resolve yet (a Testing-the-Waters page shows the perks of the round it converts into, which is still being set up).

story.description: The story in document order, as the page renders it. Empty `blocks` when the company has no story.

character_count.description: Characters of text across paragraph, heading, list, and footnote blocks.

inline_images_omitted.description: Images the page renders from an inline `data:` URL, which have no fetchable URL and are left out of `blocks`. Almost always 0.

title.description: The heading the page puts over the story (the founder's own, or the default).
